ICS 59.080.30TXD 33Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPE1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements of cotton chafer fabrics used in the manufacture of automobile tyres, other than motor-cycle and scooter tyres.1.2 This standard also gives the constructional particulars of a few popular varieties of cotton chafer fabrics for information only.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
